decisive_finding.cause: The product recover path publishes the repaired journal head before checking ambiguous operations, pending integration, stale leases, expired leases, and orphaned leases. A reachable orphaned-lease recovery therefore returns only an error after advancing authority, and retrying the prior head conflicts.

false_pass_control.missing_behavior: The suite names an orphaned-effect mutation but does not execute the recovery path with an orphaned active lease or prove recursive zero-write rejection before journal publication.

corrective_action: Preview and replay the exact authenticated interrupted append without writing, reject stale, expired, orphaned, ambiguous, pending-integration, substituted-target, and workspace-change states before publication, then use the existing locked repair primitive to revalidate and commit the same append. Add positive, negative, race, mutation, and recursive zero-write tests, including the concrete orphaned-live-worker case and a concurrent-head change between preview and commit.
